_about: What a charter at each autonomy level says by default, and the numbers the monthly reckoning uses. Edit freely; a charter keeps the terms it was signed with (terms_json), so editing this file only changes charters signed afterwards. stipend_per_year is paid monthly (one twelfth per 30-day period) by the court's steward. personnel_cap = riders the company may keep; patrols_per_week = patrols owed on the district's routes; report_every_days = how often a written report is owed to the steward; review_after_days = when the Jarl looks at the charter again. expected_power = how much military weight the court accepts at this level without worrying (1.0 = a full complement at the cap with a year's stipend in hand).

upkeep._about: Monthly cost of keeping the company, paid from its purse: pay per rider on top of board (the founder takes none) and feed and farrier per horse. Set so a level 1 company at its cap just pays its way on the stipend.

defaults_reported._about: Strength assumed until the game reports it (the cavalry mod's slice: the founder and four horses).
